text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, I've been thinking that running<n>both the turf and
dirt Mile<n>Championships is the perfect move<n>for a
true all-rounder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Which is why I'm miles from home,visiting Morioka! Get it? Miles. Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And would you believe my luck? I run<n>into
Morioka's very own Yukino!<n>She's offered me her
precious<n>support, so now I've gotta put on a<n>good
show for her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Will I manage to gain victory and chat<n>with the
locals without suffering any<n>communication
barriers?! Find out<n>next time! ☆
